title: Two-lane evidence and public-source provenance trace

lanes.label: Research evidence chain
lanes.boundary: This lane shows the frozen entity-to-claim-to-condition-to-source/statement references in the Research MVP. It does not turn a linked record into cell geometry, a coordinate, a causal extension beyond the recorded condition, or REG.

lanes.label: Public-source planning chain
lanes.boundary: This lane shows declared feasibility-planner coverage only. A route is neither a downloaded source object nor a same-cell, same-specimen, coordinate, causal, or project-registration relation.

crossLanePolicy: The two lanes are deliberately unjoined. A visual adjacency or a shared biological term does not establish an identity transfer, source-object link, same-cell relationship, coordinate transform, causal relation, asset authorization, or REG.
scientificBoundary: The trace derives immutable, declared references from bundled release contracts only. It does not acquire, inspect, hash, transform, align, combine, analyze, persist, or bundle a source object; it does not infer new evidence, biological truth, same-cell identity, spatial registration, or REG.
